description: Reviewed source changes authorized for territory, independent relay fortresses and deferred fort survivor awards. Previous hashes include the existing authorized frontline and batch edits. All other source guards remain exact.

shovelSurfaceSoftAt.reason: Reserve the successor compound ground using the same fort surface rule.

triggerExplosion.reason: Persist gate damage and dispatch the breach to the struck fort identity.

processKill.reason: Debit the victim's fort muster and record pending garrison casualties exactly once before the friendly early return.

updateEntities.reason: Keep regular civilians on captured ground during a remote relay battle.; gate isolation removes ambient actors before AI and updates counted ambushers beyond the distance cutoff

triggerGateAmbush.reason: Owned city roads cannot remuster hostile attackers inside protected territory.; gate breaches suspend the ambient world; all three opening groups belong to the same 150-person quota

checkAmbushCleared.reason: Finish the active relay records through the existing clear dispatcher.; a missing gate body returns to reserve instead of granting victory without a kill

triggerOutpostAmbush.reason: Apply the existing gate/muster behavior to the selected relay, respecting controlled spawn ground.; gate breaches despawn ambient actors instead of conscripting them; relay arrivals use the gate pursuit helper

conscriptIntoMuster.reason: Assign each conscript and its counters to the active fort identity.; isolated gate fights do not conscript overworld actors or inflate their finite quota

maintainOutpostMuster.reason: Maintain independent relays while retaining any merged native story battle counters; the native refill loop is moved to maintainFortMuster.

gateIsOpen.reason: Query the particular gate's fortress ownership record.

outpostFortState.reason: Keep legacy and independent fort keys, pending liberation/cohort state, and a persistent one-time award latch; old captured records stay paid.

activeFortMuster.reason: Select a live fort from the unlocked relay definitions.

Character.checkCol.reason: Regular city civilians stay on safe captured ground during remote ambushes; native solid collision remains unchanged.

spawnAmbushReinforcement.reason: gate reserves follow a distant player using collision-safe offscreen arrivals; standalone tower arrivals are unchanged

Character.updateEnemy.reason: isolated ambushers keep CHASE and track the player at any distance while retaining native movement, collision and firing LOS
